answer.reason: The verses give two things that happened to Zeboiim: its king joined battle in the vale of Siddim, and the LORD overthrew it in his anger.

clauses.english: went to battle with its king against Chedorlaomer and his allies in the vale of Siddim
clauses.quote: and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them

clauses.english: was overthrown by the LORD in his anger and wrath
clauses.quote: which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath

doubts: GEN 10:19 only lists Zeboim as a border point, so it was left out.
HOS 11:8 uses Zeboim as a comparison, not an event, so it was left out.
DEU 29:23 names the overthrow only in passing, as a comparison for the land's desolation.
